assumptions.identity: A wallet address alone does not grant an operator or moderator role; the write endpoint must authorize it.
assumptions.availability: Service health and moderation reads can fail independently; an unavailable service is not an empty queue.
assumptions.persistence: Only acknowledged moderation writes change shared state; some moderation actors remain previews.
assumptions.completion: Require the requested action to be acknowledged and reflected by a subsequent read; a dialog closing is insufficient.
assumptions.measurement: Separate queue inspection, attempted moderation, rejected writes and acknowledged decisions; do not mix preview decisions into throughput.

assumptions.identity: Browsing destinations does not imply a connected Explorer identity; runtime actions need the client session.
assumptions.availability: A compatible renderer and working bridge are prerequisites for client actions; a loaded web page is not a running scene.
assumptions.persistence: Navigation is local until a client acknowledges it; chat persistence must not be inferred from a send click.
assumptions.completion: Track destination arrival or bridge acknowledgement separately from opening the client or clicking Join.
assumptions.measurement: Compare entry variants on the same destination-ready cohort and count startup/connection failures as guardrails.

assumptions.identity: Visitors may explore before sign-in; opening the hub does not grant ownership or publishing permission.
assumptions.availability: File System Access support must be detected in the browser; a supported API can still be denied by the user.
assumptions.persistence: A selected folder remains local until saved or deployed; downloading a tool does not create a project.
assumptions.completion: A rendered project preview, not a download or hub click, proves the preview capability worked.
assumptions.measurement: Segment browser capability and actual preview completion; a single populated arm is instrumentation, not evidence of lift.

assumptions.identity: A valid session and ownership/delegated permission are separate requirements for each project, collection or world.
assumptions.availability: Local file access, builder storage, content deployment and world services have different failure modes.
assumptions.persistence: Local edits, backend saves and published content are distinct; metadata preview state is not a saved world setting.
assumptions.completion: Use the returned project/entity identifier and a read-back or deployment status; a finished wizard is insufficient.
assumptions.measurement: Measure first preview, saved draft and published scene separately, with failed uploads and permission denials retained.

assumptions.identity: A connected wallet is not proof of voting power, authorship or committee authority.
assumptions.availability: Proposal reads, signing, Snapshot/DAO submission and discussion services are separate dependencies.
assumptions.persistence: Drafts and preview votes are not published proposals or accepted ballots; unavailable writers must refuse.
assumptions.completion: Require an accepted proposal/vote identifier from the authoritative service; a signature or outbound link alone is insufficient.
assumptions.measurement: Report draft completion, external handoff and accepted votes separately; do not infer binding DAO outcomes from preview events.

assumptions.identity: Public event reads do not authenticate an attendee; every write must use the current, unexpired identity.
assumptions.availability: Events and notification settings are separate services; lack of a readable setting must not become an overwrite.
assumptions.persistence: Acknowledged RSVP/preference changes are shared; hangout/schedule previews and email verification have separate readiness.
assumptions.completion: RSVP succeeds after the attendee endpoint acknowledges the write; saving preferences does not prove an email was delivered.
assumptions.measurement: Distinguish real from simulated RSVP events and cancellations; measure returning attendance separately from RSVP intent.

capabilities.name: Secondary NFT purchase and NAME registration

assumptions.identity: Delegated API sign-in and on-chain wallet authority are different; ownership, chain and allowance must be checked for the action.
assumptions.availability: A readable listing does not prove checkout support; relayer/payment/chain availability must be established before requesting signatures.
assumptions.persistence: A typed-data signature is not a broadcast transaction; a transaction hash is not by itself a confirmed purchase.
assumptions.completion: Require a receipt or authoritative checkout result for the correct asset and buyer; never synthesize a token id from a signature.
assumptions.measurement: Keep reviewed listing, approval, submission and confirmed purchase distinct; unavailable flows must not emit purchase success.

assumptions.identity: Public reading needs no wallet; a handoff inherits the destination product identity requirements.
assumptions.availability: Editorial content, destination data and client launch support are independent; missing data needs an explicit empty/error distinction.
assumptions.persistence: Outbound navigation persists no purchase, attendance or scene state by itself.
assumptions.completion: An outbound click proves a handoff only; arrival and the downstream action require their own acknowledgement.
assumptions.measurement: Attribute downstream conversions only when linked by the documented session/entry context; do not equate click-through with conversion.

assumptions.identity: The recipient address is the assignment unit; browser sid is not interchangeable with that address.
assumptions.availability: Worker, notification store, presence and experiment overrides must be available; a sites page cannot attest delivery.
assumptions.persistence: Suppression, inserted notification, read flag and landing event represent different persisted facts.
assumptions.completion: Notification insertion proves emission; only a read/landing signal proves engagement, and neither proves purchase.
assumptions.measurement: Keep address-assigned worker arms separate from session experiments; preserve holdout and suppression counts in the denominator.

capabilities.name: Community creation preview and avatar/voice controls

assumptions.identity: A rendered overlay does not guarantee a wallet, community role or renderer session; never substitute simulation when anonymous.
assumptions.availability: Social API, renderer bridge and media permission are independent; microphone permission is not room admission.
assumptions.persistence: Membership requires an acknowledged signed write; local avatar/voice state and preview-created communities are not shared persistence.
assumptions.completion: Distinguish joined membership from a pending private-community request, and room admission from an unmuted microphone.
assumptions.measurement: Measure acknowledged join/request, saved outfit and voice admission separately; preview actions must stay identifiable.
